page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 128 virtual CPUs and 512.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor infrastructure and does not include discrete GPU accelerators.

The instance provides substantial network throughput with a baseline bandwidth of 160 Gbps, supporting efficient data transfer between nodes and external services. However, ecs.g7nex.32xlarge includes no integrated local disk storage, requiring persistent storage to be attached via network-connected volumes. Its high hardware resource density offers significant core count and memory capacity within a single node, making it suitable for large-scale enterprise applications, microservice clusters, CI/CD execution environments, and web serving fleets.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.32xlarge is a general-purpose, x86_64 instance provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at 2.7 GHz, paired with 512.0 GB of memory to yield a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Designed without discrete GPU hardware or local disk storage, all storage dependencies rely on attached cloud block volumes. The instance delivers high networking performance with a baseline bandwidth of 160 Gbps, enabling efficient data transfer across large distributed deployments. Its vCPU and memory capacities suit demanding enterprise applications, containerized microservice architectures, continuous integration builds, and scale-out web serving fleets.
